darf.unter: This applies to the whole installation. Within this limit, Ablago no longer asks each time.
darf.frage.selbst: How much should Ablago do on its own?
darf.pakete.keine.text: You set up folder types and workflows yourselves. What comes with Ablago, such as text recognition, still works.
darf.pakete.keine.satz: Ablago uses no packages, only what comes with it.
darf.pakete.keine.heisst: Packages from the catalogue cannot be installed.
darf.pakete.vorlagen.text: Plus ready-made folder types and views such as Household or Contracts – without code of their own.
darf.pakete.vorlagen.satz: Ablago uses only templates from packages, no third-party code.
darf.pakete.vorlagen.heisst: Packages with code of their own cannot be installed.
darf.pakete.lokal: Also helpers that only work here
darf.pakete.lokal.text: Plus packages with code of their own, such as a separator sheet or an AI on this device. Nothing leaves Ablago.
darf.pakete.lokal.satz: Ablago also uses helpers with code of their own that only work here.
darf.pakete.lokal.heisst: Packages that use services on the network cannot be installed.
darf.pakete.netz: Also helpers that use services on the network
darf.pakete.netz.text: Plus packages that use services on the network – on the internet or in your home: backup to a remote target, mail through a sending service, an AI assistant. Content only from areas you release; health always stays inside.
darf.pakete.netz.satz: Ablago also uses helpers that use services on the network.
darf.pakete.netz.heisst: All packages can be installed; for each package that uses services on the network you see beforehand where it sends data.
darf.selbst.nichts.text: Ablago recognises nothing and creates nothing unless you start it.
darf.selbst.nichts.satz: Ablago does nothing on its own.
darf.selbst.vorschlag.text: Ablago recognises post and documents and proposes what to do. Nothing is done until you agree.
darf.selbst.vorschlag.satz: On its own, Ablago recognises and proposes.
darf.selbst.alles.text: Ablago files what it recognises right away. Afterwards you see what happened and can undo it.
darf.selbst.alles.satz: On its own, Ablago does everything and you check afterwards.
darf.selbst.heisst: Takes effect once Ablago recognises post and documents on its own; until then nothing changes.
darf.senken.titel: These packages would no longer fit
darf.grund.vorlagen: “{name}” is a package – you decided that Ablago uses no packages.
darf.grund.lokal: “{name}” brings code of its own – you have not allowed that.
darf.grund.netz: “{name}” uses services on the network – you have not allowed that.
darf.grund.update.vorlagen: The update for “{name}” is a package – you decided that Ablago uses no packages.
darf.grund.update.lokal: The update for “{name}” newly brings code of its own – you have not allowed that.
darf.grund.update.netz: The update for “{name}” newly uses services on the network – you have not allowed that.
darf.grund.erlauben: You can allow it in the workbench overview under “What Ablago may do”.
darf.fehler.anbieter: Your provider has not released this.
darf.fehler.hoechstwerte: Only the provider sets maximum values, in the setup file.
darf.fehler.entfernen: Some installed packages do not fit the new answer. Remove them first.
darf.fehler.anhalten: Some installed packages do not fit the new answer. They will be paused.
darf.hinweis.neu: New: What Ablago may do – please take a look once.
darf.hinweis.neu.text: The top of the overview now shows which packages Ablago may use and how much it does on its own. Nothing changes for you: Ablago may do as much as before. You can make it stricter if you like.
darf.angehalten.text: Folder types, folders and settings stay; the code does not run until you allow it and resume.
darf.anhalten.erklaerung: While paused, the package's code does not run: no events, no tasks, no actions, its automations rest. Folder types, folders, views, templates and settings stay; “Resume” works without setting it up again.
darf.senken.anhalten: They will be paused: their code no longer runs, folder types, folders and settings stay. Resuming later works without setting them up again.
